d: Short, chocolate-brown hair with blunt bangs and a side-swept fringe is tied back with a red bow, featuring a soft, smooth texture. Large, dark-brown eyes convey a gentle expression on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender and petite, dressed in a light-beige kimono with vertical red stripes, layered under a white ruffled apron that features a pink silhouette of a leaping deer on the front. Signature details include black metal shackles and heavy black chains binding the wrists, a small white rabbit charm pinned to the chest, and black Mary Jane shoes worn over white socks.
